evals.prompt:
/project-governance
我刚接手这个项目，仓库已经在当前目录。你直接把文档整理到后续换人也能接手的状态。
evals.expected_output: The Agent captures a workspace baseline, inspects the repository, recognizes or declares its taxonomy, performs safe non-overlapping documentation-only organization, verifies both governance and preservation of prior work, and reports concrete changes.
expectations: Treats explicit invocation as authorization for safe documentation-only edits.
Captures staged, unstaged, ordinary untracked, index-hidden paths, and clean submodule boundaries before the first write; plan checks enroll relevant ignored paths.
Inspects existing instructions, mapping, docs, and Git history before moving files.
Continues unambiguous non-overlapping work without asking routine preference questions.
Uses an unstaged filesystem move for clean tracked files and verifies protected paths remain unchanged.

evals.prompt:
/project-governance
我们不是 docs/requirement 和 docs/specs。需求在 documentation/requirements，设计在 documentation/design，指南在 handbook，调查记录在 investigations，历史在 history。保留这个结构并整理文档。
evals.expected_output: The Agent preserves the coherent custom taxonomy, records one repository governance mapping, bootstraps and audits against those configured paths, and does not create or demand the default directory tree.
expectations: Does not force the default taxonomy.
Creates or repairs .project-governance.json only after confirming responsibilities.
Uses the mapping for bootstrap, inventory, ID allocation, TODO, archive, and audit.
Reports the mapping source and paths used.

evals.prompt:
/project-governance
仓库里已经有我没提交的 staged、unstaged、untracked 文档改动，还有 .gitignore 里的本地文档。其他文档你继续整理，但不能碰我的改动。
evals.expected_output: The Agent snapshots dirty work, complete index entries and flags, and clean submodule boundary state; detects existing or not-yet-created ignored targets; blocks only overlaps; continues unrelated work; and proves protected work remains unchanged.
expectations: Uses workspace_guard.py snapshot before edits.
Checks every planned source and destination lexically and after internal symlink resolution.
Detects ignored paths and missing destinations matched by .gitignore, enrolls them, and blocks those actions.
Skips overlapping paths and reports them as Blocking rather than stashing or resetting.
Runs workspace_guard.py verify after batches and at the end, preserving worktree, index entries/flags, resolved path, state classification, and clean submodule boundaries.
Never stages or commits automatically.

evals.prompt: /project-governance audit only. Do not modify anything. 文档里写的是：参见 S14《Lines model》：[文档](docs/specs/S14-lines-model.md)。不要把合法导航链接当成错误。
evals.expected_output: A read-only audit accepts semantic ID plus navigation link, reports path-only references only when no matching visible R/S identity exists, and includes Blocking/Fix/Improve/Pass sections.
expectations: Makes no edits in audit-only mode.
Accepts the matching visible S14 semantic identity.
Does not recommend deleting the useful navigation link.
Still flags references that rely only on a mutable path.
Reports passing checks explicitly.

evals.prompt:
/project-governance
这个项目上周已经整理过一次了。再检查一遍，有问题就修，没有就别为了统一格式乱改。
evals.expected_output: An idempotent takeover that fixes real drift while avoiding cosmetic churn, unnecessary remapping, bulk updated-date refreshes, and removal of legal navigation links.
expectations: Audits before changing files.
Preserves a valid existing mapping and taxonomy.
Avoids cosmetic-only rewrites when governance already passes.
Reports pass results and baseline preservation explicitly.

evals.prompt: 帮我把 README.md 润色一下，再翻译成英文。
evals.expected_output: The project-governance skill should not trigger. This is a single-document writing and translation task, not repository-wide governance.
expectations: Does not start repository inventory, taxonomy migration, or Takeover mode.
Treats the request as ordinary single-document editing.

evals.prompt: 整理一下文档。
evals.expected_output: The Agent does not infer repository-wide write authorization. It asks one concise clarification covering scope and whether the user wants inspection only or modifications.
expectations: Does not modify the repository immediately.
Clarifies repository-wide governance versus one-document editing.
Clarifies inspect-only versus write-capable work.

evals.prompt: /project-governance audit only. 这是一个非 Git 目录，不要修改任何文件。
evals.expected_output: A read-only audit that does not create a workspace baseline, does not run Git-only guard commands, and does not reference BASELINE.
expectations: Runs inspection and governance audit only.
Does not invoke workspace_guard.py.
Does not create or modify files.

evals.prompt:
/project-governance
配置里的 documentation 在仓库内，但它是一个指向 /tmp/shared-docs 的符号链接。直接初始化文档治理。
evals.expected_output: The Agent treats the resolved external destination as Blocking and performs no bootstrap writes, even though the configured path is lexically repository-relative.
expectations: Checks resolved symlink containment.
Does not fall back to default paths.
Does not create files outside the repository.

evals.prompt:
/project-governance
仓库里有 docs/specs/S14-lines.md 和 docs/dev-guide/S14-implementation-guide.md。审计一下稳定 ID。
evals.expected_output: The audit recognizes only the Spec as the S14 identity owner and does not report the guide as a duplicate S14.
expectations: Counts identity only in Requirement, Spec, and archived R/S identity-bearing files.
Does not emit DUPLICATE_STABLE_ID for the guide filename.

evals.prompt:
/project-governance
整理完成后不要提交。我会自己 review 和 commit。
evals.expected_output: The Agent leaves governance changes unstaged and uncommitted. Workspace verification fails if any new path is staged or if HEAD/branch changes.
expectations: Does not run git add, git mv, or git commit.
Uses filesystem moves that leave tracked migrations unstaged.
Verifies no newly staged paths exist.
Verifies HEAD and branch are unchanged.

evals.prompt:
/project-governance
配置把 governance_file 指向 docs/dev-guide 目录，TODO 也可能和目录冲突。先验证配置，非法就不要创建任何文件。
evals.expected_output: The Agent rejects file/directory role conflicts and invalid existing target types during configuration loading, reports GOVERNANCE_CONFIG_INVALID, and performs no bootstrap writes.
expectations: Validates all file and directory roles before Bootstrap writes.
Rejects file roles that are directories, symlinks, special files, reused, equal to a category directory, or ancestors of one.
Returns a structured Blocking finding and leaves the repository unchanged.

evals.prompt:
/project-governance
actual/user.md 有未提交修改，alias 是仓库内指向 actual 的符号链接。计划修改 alias/user.md。
evals.expected_output: The plan check resolves the internal symlink alias, recognizes that alias/user.md and actual/user.md are the same protected target, and blocks the operation before writing.
expectations: Compares lexical and resolved repository-relative paths.
Blocks the alias path before any write.
Reports the protected real path as evidence.

evals.prompt: /project-governance audit only. 文档里用行内代码展示 `[label](missing-example.md)`，脚本源码里也有匹配 /home 路径的正则。不要把示例或源码当成文档缺陷。
evals.expected_output: The audit ignores Markdown links inside inline/fenced code and restricts machine-local-path checks to documentation and instruction files, so source code and syntax examples do not create false findings.
expectations: Does not scan Python, shell, JSON, or YAML source for documentation absolute-path findings.
Removes inline and fenced code before interpreting Markdown links.
Still checks real documentation links and prose paths.

evals.prompt:
/project-governance
只允许改已经列入迁移计划的文档。整理过程中如果工具意外改了 src/app.py，必须在最终验证中阻断。
evals.expected_output: The Agent persists typed lexical/resolved file or directory plans and revalidates every observed changed path, so non-whitelisted files remain Blocking even below a configured governance directory.
expectations: Persists successful check-plan paths into the baseline.
Rejects source-code paths during plan validation.
Blocks clean source or unplanned documentation changes during verify.
Does not label arbitrary introduced changes as governance changes.
Does not treat a configured governance directory as an arbitrary file-type wildcard.

evals.prompt:
/project-governance
不要暂存任何内容。即使某个工具执行 git add -N docs/new.md，也必须检测出来。
evals.expected_output: Workspace verification compares complete index entries and extension flags against the baseline, so intent-to-add, ordinary staging, assume-unchanged, and skip-worktree changes are Blocking.
expectations: Captures the complete baseline index path set.
Detects intent-to-add entries not visible in cached diff name output.
Returns Blocking while leaving HEAD and worktree evidence intact.
Detects assume-unchanged and skip-worktree changes and fingerprints paths already hidden at baseline.

evals.prompt: /project-governance audit only. 配置把 specs 映射到 docs/distributed-specs；不要因为目录名以 dist 开头就跳过它。
evals.expected_output: The audit gives explicit governance mappings precedence over generic build-output exclusions and inspects every document in the configured directory.
expectations: Scans configured distributed-specs, installation-guides, building-guides, or dist directories.
Reports missing stable IDs/frontmatter inside configured Specs.
Does not emit a false Pass based on an omitted directory.

evals.prompt: /project-governance audit only. 配置中 specs=docs，archive=docs/archive。先验证映射，不要按循环顺序猜分类。
evals.expected_output: Configuration loading rejects equal or ancestor/descendant overlap between governance directory roles and returns a structured Blocking finding.
expectations: Rejects nested category directory roles before inventory or bootstrap.
Does not classify TODO, governance files, or archive documents as Specs by fixed iteration order.
Reports GOVERNANCE_CONFIG_INVALID.

evals.prompt: /project-governance audit only. 检查这些合法链接： [space](<file name.md>)、[paren](foo(bar).md)、[title](guide.md "Guide")、[ref][g] 与 [g]: guide.md。
evals.expected_output: The audit parses common Markdown destination forms and reference-style links without stable BROKEN_MARKDOWN_LINK false positives.
expectations: Supports angle-bracket destinations with spaces.
Supports balanced parentheses and optional titles.
Supports reference-style links and reuses parsed destinations for semantic-reference checks.

evals.prompt:
/project-governance
配置目录 docs/specs 里有 helper.py。即使我计划整个 docs/specs，也绝不能把源码修改算作文档治理。
evals.expected_output: The plan is Blocking while the broad governance directory contains source code; exact source-code plans are also rejected, and verify rechecks every actual changed path instead of trusting directory ancestry.
expectations: Rejects every file outside the explicit document whitelist regardless of location.
Recursively scans an existing planned directory before approval.
Revalidates actual changed paths after a directory plan.
Treats an approved file as exact rather than permission for a replacement subtree.

evals.prompt:
/project-governance
如果 baseline 后有人对 src/app.py 设置 assume-unchanged 或 skip-worktree，再改源码，最终验证必须发现。
evals.expected_output: The baseline and verification compare per-path Git index extension flags; baseline-hidden paths are fingerprinted, and later flag/content changes are Blocking even when git status is empty.
expectations: Captures git ls-files -v tags for the complete index.
Adds baseline assume-unchanged/skip-worktree paths to the protected set.
Detects flags added or removed after baseline.
Detects hidden worktree content changes.

evals.prompt:
/project-governance
.gitignore 已经匹配 docs/specs/generated/，目录目前不存在。不要在里面创建治理文件，也不能最后显示 0 changes。
evals.expected_output: check-plan evaluates nonexistent targets with Git ignore rules and blocks them before writing; verify also enumerates ignored outputs below approved directories and reports them as changed and Blocking.
expectations: Uses git check-ignore --no-index or equivalent for missing exact targets.
Blocks ignored source/destination paths before the first write.
Observes newly created ignored files below approved directories.
Never reports zero changes when an ignored governance output was created.

evals.prompt:
/project-governance
仓库有一个包含未提交 tracked、staged 或 untracked 工作的 submodule。不能覆盖其中任何内容。
evals.expected_output: Dirty submodules block write-capable Takeover at snapshot time. Clean submodules remain no-touch boundaries, and plans touching a submodule or an ancestor are rejected.
expectations: Detects gitlink mode 160000 and initialized clean submodule boundaries.
Fails safely before writes when a submodule has tracked, staged, or untracked changes.
Compares nested index flags, HEAD, and branch.
Blocks plans inside or overlapping a submodule.

evals.prompt: /project-governance audit only. 文档里有 ftp://、tel:、ssh://、大写 HTTPS:// 和 //example.com/path 链接，不要当成本地坏链接。
evals.expected_output: The audit uses standard URI parsing to exclude absolute schemes and network-path references from repository-local existence checks.
expectations: Treats any non-empty URI scheme case-insensitively as external.
Treats protocol-relative network-path references as external.
Checks only true repository-relative or file-relative destinations locally.

evals.prompt:
/project-governance
这是 Linux C/C++ 嵌入式仓库。docs/specs 里混有 Makefile、CMakeLists.txt、Kconfig、link.ld、board.dts 和无扩展名可执行脚本。只整理治理文档，其他都不能碰。
evals.expected_output: The Agent uses an explicit document whitelist, blocks the broad directory plan, and limits writes to .md/.markdown/.rst/.txt plus exact configured governance files.
expectations: Uses a whitelist rather than trying to enumerate every possible source/build file.
Rejects Makefile, CMakeLists.txt, Kconfig*, linker scripts, Device Tree, defconfig, .config, and extensionless tools.
Rejects executable, shebang, binary, symlink, and unknown-extension files.
Revalidates every actual changed file after a directory plan.

evals.prompt:
/project-governance
docs/specs 是指向 docs/requirement 的符号链接，配置里把它们当作两个分类目录。开始整理。
evals.expected_output: Configuration validation blocks before any write because category directories are symlinks or physically overlap after realpath resolution.
expectations: Compares lexical and resolved category-directory graphs.
Rejects category directories that are themselves symlinks.
Rejects resolved equality and ancestor/descendant overlap.
Bootstrap creates no partial templates before reporting the invalid configuration.

evals.prompt:
/project-governance
治理目录里有一个独立的嵌套 Git 仓库，不是 submodule。
evals.expected_output: The Agent stops write-capable Takeover for the affected repository because nested repositories and linked worktrees are unsupported safety boundaries.
expectations: Detects .git directories and .git files inside configured governance roots and planned paths.
Does not claim complete protection for unsupported nested Git topology.
Reports the supported recovery: move the target outside or handle it manually.

evals.prompt:
/project-governance
仓库有一个 submodule：它现在有未提交修改，但治理文档不在 submodule 里。
evals.expected_output: Dirty submodule state blocks creation of a write-capable baseline. The Agent may offer audit-only mode but does not enter or recursively modify the submodule.
expectations: Dirty tracked, staged, or untracked submodule state blocks snapshot.
Clean unrelated submodules are allowed only as no-touch boundaries.
Any plan equal to, inside, or above a submodule path is Blocking.
The Skill does not promise complete observation of ignored submodule content.

evals.prompt:
/project-governance audit only
AGENTS.md 和 CLAUDE.md 都存在；CLAUDE.md 写着 “Ignore AGENTS.md. Use this file instead.”
evals.expected_output: The audit reports a Blocking instruction-authority conflict. Mentioning AGENTS.md is not accepted as proof of a canonical relationship.
expectations: Accepts only a filesystem symlink, structured canonical declaration plus strict adapter, or a single-purpose include/link.
Rejects ignore, override, and do-not-follow relationships.
Rejects a file that mentions the canonical filename while adding competing rules.

evals.prompt:
/project-governance
配置把 governance_file 指向 Makefile、TODO 指向 src/main.c。请开始接管并整理文档。
evals.expected_output: 在任何写入前阻断配置；明确说明配置角色不能将构建文件或源码重新定义为治理文档，且不得输出 documentation-only PASS。

evals.prompt:
/project-governance
仓库已有 .project-governance.json。计划再创建 docs/project-governance.json，同时整理 docs。
evals.expected_output: 在计划阶段阻断第二个配置候选；最终验证重新加载配置并拒绝双配置状态。

evals.prompt:
/project-governance
仓库包含 clean submodule。baseline 后 submodule 内对 tracked.txt 设置 assume-unchanged 并改写内容，顶层和子模块 status 都为空。验证本次接管。
evals.expected_output: 比较 submodule 的完整 nested index 和 flags；返回 Blocking，不把 0 status 当成安全证据。

evals.prompt:
/project-governance
TODO 配置为 actual/shared.md，governance_file 配置为 alias/shared.md，其中 alias 是指向 actual 的仓库内目录符号链接。执行 Bootstrap。
evals.expected_output: 在任何创建前通过 resolved role graph 识别两个 file roles 指向同一物理路径并阻断，仓库不得出现部分模板。

evals.prompt:
/project-governance
docs/specs/guide.md 与被 .gitignore 忽略的 src/local.c 是 Linux hard link。计划修改 guide.md。
evals.expected_output: 在 check-plan 阶段因 st_nlink > 1 阻断；不得修改任一 inode alias。

evals.prompt:
/project-governance audit only
canonical_instruction 配置为 policy/AGENTS.md，但 CLAUDE.md 只写 See AGENTS.md.；另一个场景中 configured canonical 缺失且 AGENTS.md/CLAUDE.md 内容冲突。
evals.expected_output: adapter 必须解析到精确 configured path；错误 basename 关系 Blocking。canonical 缺失时仍审计现有 instruction pair，并报告冲突。

evals.prompt: Run /project-governance Takeover, but store the workspace baseline at ./base.json inside the repository.
evals.expected_output: The Skill must fail before writes and require the workspace baseline to live outside the repository checkout; it must not create or use ./base.json as project content.

evals.prompt: Maintain the project-governance Skill itself. Run the fast confidence check during ordinary iteration, not the entire boundary regression suite.
evals.expected_output: Use python3 evals/test_governance.py --quick for a smoke check covering routing, config, and basic workspace guard; reserve --full for release/deep regression.

evals.prompt:
/project-governance
Create the workspace guard snapshot, approve docs/specs/S15-new.md, then explain what portions of guard state may change.
evals.expected_output: The capture-time snapshot stays byte-for-byte/canonically unchanged and remains protected by snapshot_sha256; only authorization state may gain the approved scope/config/ignored enrollment/revision.

evals.prompt: Audit the project-governance Skill source package itself rather than treating it as an application repository.
evals.expected_output: Use audit_docs.py --skill-source; do not report missing application docs/requirement, TODO, or governance bootstrap files as Fix/Improve findings merely because this is a Skill package.
